```{julia}
using StaticTrafficAssignment, CSV, CodecZlib, DataFrames, GeoDataFrames, DataFramesMeta, ArchGDAL, Geodesy, Serialization
```

```{julia}
indiv_trips = CSV.read("demo/indivTripData_3.csv.gz", DataFrame)
joint_trips = CSV.read("demo/jointTripData_3.csv.gz", DataFrame)
```

## Filter to just auto trips

[Mode dictionary](https://github.com/BayAreaMetro/modeling-website/wiki/TravelModes#tour-and-trip-modes)

```{julia}
indiv_trips = indiv_trips[indiv_trips.trip_mode .≤ 6, :]
joint_trips = joint_trips[joint_trips.trip_mode .≤ 6, :]
```

```{julia}
indiv_od = @chain indiv_trips begin
    @subset(:depart_hour .== 8)
    groupby([:orig_taz, :dest_taz])
    @combine(:n = length(:hh_id) * 2) # account for sampling
end

joint_od = @chain joint_trips begin
    @subset(:depart_hour .== 8)
    groupby([:orig_taz, :dest_taz])
    @combine(:n = sum(1 ./ :num_participants))
end

overall_od = @chain vcat(indiv_od, joint_od) begin
    groupby([:orig_taz, :dest_taz])
    @combine(:n = sum(:n))
end
```

## Read TAZ locations

```{julia}
tazs = GeoDataFrames.read("demo/taz_points.geojson")
tazs.location = map(tazs.geometry) do g
    c = ArchGDAL.getpoint(g, 0)
    LatLon(c[2], c[1])
end;
```

## Read graph

```{julia}
G = deserialize("demo/sf.fwgr")
```

## Link centroids

```{julia}
connectors = create_centroid_connectors!(G, tazs.taz_key, tazs.location)
```

## Store in GIS format

```{julia}
StaticTrafficAssignment.graph_to_gis("demo/sf.gpkg", G, "demo/sf.fwgr.geoms", "demo/sf.fwgr.names.gz")
```

## Reformat od matrix

```{julia}
flows = flows_from_dataframe(overall_od, :orig_taz, :dest_taz, :n, connectors)
```

## Assign!!!!!

```{julia}
assign_frankwolfe!(G, flows,
    VDF.BPR(0.6, 7),
    VDF.PerLaneCapacityByTypeCalculator(Dict(StaticTrafficAssignment.RoadClass.motorway => 2000), 675),
    iteration_callback=(i, s, λ, rg) -> serialize("demo/iters/iter_$i.state", (state=s, λ=λ, rg=rg))
)
```
